5.4.2.original_text: 5.4.2 Quality management system planning: Top management of the manufacturer shall ensure that.-(a) the planning of the quality management system is carried out in order to meet the specified requirements, as well as the quality objectives; and (b) the integrity of the quality management system is maintained when changes to the quality management system are planned and implemented.

5.5.2.original_text: 5.5.2 Management representative: Top management shall appoint a member of management who, irrespective of other responsibilities, shall have responsibility and authority that includes:-(a) ensuring that processes needed for the quality management system are established, implemented and maintained; (b) reporting to top management on the performance of the quality management system and any need for improvement; and (c) ensuring the promotion of awareness of regulatory and customer requirements throughout the manufacturing organization.
5.5.2.semantic_note: Management Representative - Individual responsible for maintaining QMS.

5.5.3.rationale_zh: 文本指出“高层管理人员应确保在制造组织内建立适当的沟通流程，并就质量管理体系的有效性进行沟通。” 这涵盖了内部沟通，但缺乏对记录程序或特定渠道的细节。
5.5.3.original_text: 5.5.3 Internal communication: Top management shall ensure that appropriate communication processes are established within the Manufacturing organisation and that communication takes place regarding the effectiveness of the quality management system.
5.5.3.semantic_note: Internal Communication - Ensuring information flows effectively within the organization.

6.2.rationale_en: The text explicitly addresses personnel competence (education, training, skills, experience), adequate staffing levels, medical examinations before and periodically after employment, and record-keeping related to these aspects. This covers the requirements of ISO 13485:2016 clause 6.2.
6.2.rationale_zh: 文本明确涉及人员能力（教育、培训、技能、经验）、充足的员工数量、就业前和就业后定期进行体检以及与这些方面相关的记录保存。这涵盖了ISO 13485:2016 第 6.2 条的要求。
6.2.original_text: 6.2 Human resources.-6.2.1 General: Personnel performing work affecting product quality shall be competent on the basis of appropriate education, training, skills and experience. Number of personnel employed shall be adequate and in direct proportion to the workload. Prior to employment, all personnel, shall undergo medical examination including eye examination, and shall be free from communicable or contagious diseases. Thereafter, they should be medically examined periodically, at least once a year. Records shall be maintained thereof.

7.5.4.original_text: 7.5.4 Customer property: The manufacturer shall exercise care with customer property while it is under the manufacturer’s control or being used by the manufacturer. The manufacturer shall identify, verify, protect and safeguard customer property provided for use or incorporation into the product. If any customer property is lost, damaged or otherwise found to be unsuitable for use, this shall be reported to the customer and records maintained.

7.6.original_text: 7.6 Control of monitoring and measuring devices: The manufacturer shall determine the monitoring and measurement to be undertaken and the monitoring and measuring devices needed to provide evidence of conformity of product to determined requirements. The manufacturer shall establish documented procedures to ensure that monitoring and measurement can be carried out and are carried out in a manner that is consistent with the monitoring and measurement requirements. Where necessary to ensure valid results, measuring equipment shall be:-(a) calibrated or verified at specified intervals, or prior to use, against measurement standards traceable to Bureau of Indian Standards

This aligns with the intent of ISO 8.2.3 regarding monitoring and measurement of processes but lacks detail on specific methods or data analysis.
8.2.3.rationale_zh: 该法规要求制造商监控与满足客户和监管要求相关的信息，建立反馈系统以尽早发现质量问题，并采取纠正/预防措施。这符合ISO 8.2.3关于过程监测和测量意图，但缺乏有关具体方法或数据分析的详细信息。
8.2.3.original_text: The manufacturer shall monitor information relating to whether the manufacturer has met customer or regulatory requirements... The manufacturer shall establish a documented procedure for a feedback system to provide early warning of quality problems and for input into the corrective and preventive action processes. 8.2.3 Monitoring and measurement of processes: The manufacturer shall apply suitable methods for monitoring and, where applicable, measurement of the quality management system processes.
8.2.3.semantic_note: Focuses on feedback systems and process performance.

8.2.4.rationale_en: The regulation mandates internal audits at planned intervals to determine conformity with planned arrangements, this Schedule, and the manufacturer's quality management system requirements, as well as effective implementation and maintenance. This directly addresses ISO 8.2.4.
8.2.4.rationale_zh: 该法规规定必须在计划的时间间隔内进行内部审计，以确定其是否符合计划安排、本规程以及制造商的质量管理体系要求，并有效实施和维护。这直接解决了ISO 8.2.4。
8.2.4.original_text: The manufacturer shall conduct internal audits at planned intervals to determine whether the quality management system:-(a) conforms to the planned arrangements, to the requirements of this Schedule and to the quality management system requirements established by the manufacturer; and (b) is effectively implemented and maintained.
8.2.4.semantic_note: Covers audit planning, criteria, scope, frequency, methods, auditor selection, objectivity, impartiality, responsibilities, reporting, and records.

8.2.4.1.rationale_en: The provided text does not contain specific requirements for internal audit criteria, scope, frequency or methods.
8.2.4.1.rationale_zh: 提供的文本不包含有关内部审计标准、范围、频率或方法的具体要求。

8.2.4.2.rationale_en: The regulation requires actions to be taken without undue delay to eliminate detected nonconformities and their causes, followed by verification of the actions and reporting of results. This aligns with ISO 8.2.4.2 regarding corrective action.
8.2.4.2.rationale_zh: 该法规要求采取措施，在不应延误的情况下消除发现的不符合项及其原因，然后验证这些措施并报告结果。这与ISO 8.2.4.2中关于纠正措施的要求一致。
8.2.4.2.original_text: The management responsible for the area being audited shall ensure that actions are taken without undue delay to eliminate detected nonconformities and their causes. Follow-up activities shall include the verification of the actions taken and the reporting of verification results.
8.2.4.2.semantic_note: Addresses corrective action implementation and verification.

8.2.5.rationale_en: The regulation states that manufacturers shall apply suitable methods for monitoring and measurement of quality management system processes to demonstrate the ability of these processes to achieve planned results. This partially covers ISO 8.2.5, but lacks detail on specific control measures.
8.2.5.rationale_zh: 该法规规定制造商应采用适当的方法来监控和测量质量管理体系的过程，以证明这些过程能够实现计划的结果。这部分涵盖了ISO 8.2.5，但缺乏有关具体控制措施的详细信息。
8.2.5.original_text: The manufacturer shall apply suitable methods for monitoring and, where applicable, measurement of the quality management system processes. These methods shall demonstrate the ability of the processes to achieve planned results.
8.2.5.semantic_note: Focuses on process monitoring and measurement.

8.2.6.rationale_en: The provided text does not contain specific requirements for monitoring and measurement of product.
8.2.6.rationale_zh: 提供的文本不包含有关产品监控和测量的具体要求。

8.3.rationale_en: The provided text does not contain specific requirements for nonconforming product control - general.
8.3.rationale_zh: 提供的文本不包含有关不合格品控制的一般性具体要求。

8.3.1.rationale_en: The provided text does not contain specific requirements for nonconforming product control - before delivery.
8.3.1.rationale_zh: 提供的文本不包含有关交付前不合格品控制的具体要求。

8.3.2.rationale_en: The provided text does not mention post-delivery nonconforming product control.
8.3.2.rationale_zh: 提供的文本未提及交付后不合格品管制。

8.3.3.rationale_en: The provided text does not mention concession of nonconforming products.
8.3.3.rationale_zh: 提供的文本未提及不合格品的让步。

8.3.4.rationale_en: The text mentions 'rework' and requires a determination of any adverse effect upon product, which aligns with the intent of rework control but lacks detail on specific procedures.
8.3.4.rationale_zh: 文本提到了“返工”并要求确定对产品造成的任何不利影响，这与返工控制的意图相符，但缺乏具体程序细节。
8.3.4.original_text: Prior to authorisation and approval of the work instruction, a determination of any adverse effect of the rework upon product shall be made and documented.
8.3.4.english_translation: 在工作指导授权和批准之前，应确定并记录返工对产品造成的任何不利影响。

8.4.rationale_en: The text states that the manufacturer shall establish documented procedures to determine, collect and analyze appropriate data to demonstrate suitability and effectiveness of the QMS.
8.4.rationale_zh: 文本规定制造商应建立记录程序，以确定、收集和分析适当的数据，以证明质量管理体系的适用性和有效性。
8.4.original_text: The manufacturer shall establish documented procedures to determine, collect and analyze appropriate data to demonstrate the suitability and effectiveness of the quality management system and to evaluate whether improvement of the effectiveness of the quality management system can be made.
8.4.english_translation: 制造商应建立记录程序，以确定、收集和分析适当的数据，以证明质量管理体系的适用性和有效性，并评估是否可以提高质量管理体系的有效性。

8.5.1.rationale_en: The text mentions identifying and implementing changes to maintain the QMS's suitability and effectiveness, aligning with the general improvement clause but lacks detail on specific methods.
8.5.1.rationale_zh: 文本提到了识别和实施维持质量管理体系适用性和有效性的变更，与一般改进条款相符，但缺乏具体方法细节。
8.5.1.original_text: The manufacturer shall identify and implement any changes necessary to ensure and maintain the continued suitability and effectiveness of the quality management system...
8.5.1.english_translation: 制造商应识别和实施所有必要的变更，以确保并维持质量管理体系的持续适用性和有效性……

8.5.2.rationale_en: The text requires records of customer complaint investigations to be maintained, which directly addresses corrective action requirements.
8.5.2.rationale_zh: 文本要求维护客户投诉调查记录，这直接解决了纠正措施的要求。
8.5.2.original_text: Records of all customer complaint investigations shall be maintained.
8.5.2.english_translation: 应维护所有客户投诉调查的记录。

8.5.3.rationale_zh: 提供的文本未提及预防措施。
